target_audience: Blue-collar gig delivery drivers (Uber, DoorDash, Spark, Lyft, Instacart)

colors.gradients: No soft gradients. Use hard stops or subtle noise textures.

spacing_and_layout.system: Tailwind standard scale, utilizing generous padding (p-6, p-8) for containers.
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid. Asymmetrical, gap-8, overlapping elements.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid. Dense density, col-span-1 to 3 variations, gap-4 to gap-6. All pixels utilized.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Sharp or minimal radius. Default to rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px). Containers use 1px solid #333333.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: Neo-brutalist solid drop shadows for key actions (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#D4FF00]) or flat surfaces without shadows.

components.buttons: Square edges, solid primary color background, black text. Hover state translates up (-translate-y-1) and expands solid shadow.
components.cards: Flat background (#1A1A1A) with 1px border (#333333). Optional 'Grid Borders' style where borders collapse.
components.navigation: Crystal Glass effect for sticky headers: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 with 1px border-b #333333.
components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn components heavily customized: sharp corners, transparent backgrounds, 1px border. Focus state must use primary color (#D4FF00) ring.
components.data_tables: Dense layout, monospace font for numbers, subtle border-b on rows, no zebra striping.

icons.style: duotone or bold weights to match tactical feel

image_urls.description: Delivery rider navigating city streets at evening rush hour, perfect for the landing page hero section.
Food delivery rider on motorbike at night, used for the mileage tracking feature section.
Illuminated car dashboard at night, useful as a background or contextual image for the Live Mileage Tracker UI.
Woman holding a long receipt, perfect for illustrating the AI OCR receipt scanning feature.

media.treatment: All images used as backgrounds must include an overlay of bg-black/60 to ensure text contrast. Use grayscale + tinting for a uniform aesthetic if needed.

motion.interactions: Snappy, precise transitions. No slow fades. Use framer-motion for micro-interactions (e.g., button press scaling down).
motion.loading_states: Tactical ASCII loaders or fast-moving monospace data streams rather than generic spinners.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds meets 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG ratios.
accessibility.focus_states: High-visibility focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4FF00] focus:outline-none) on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid SaaS dashboard + marketing page. Do NOT use default blue/white generic themes. Enforce the Dark Theme.
Use Tailwind for all layout and styling. Strip Shadcn of its default Vercel-look (soft corners, soft shadows).
Install Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono'. Use them explicitly in tailwind.config.js.
For the marketing page, use Pure HTML+Tailwind for layouts, use pure asymmetry, do not perfectly center everything. Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling.
For the dashboard, use the 'Control Room' grid system. Ensure widgets stretch to match neighbors using h-full.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and major data points.
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the exact URLs provided in the media section.
The primary CTA color is #D4FF00 (Volt Yellow). Use it for critical actions like 'Start Trip', 'Upgrade', 'Sign Up'.
